failedHint: Fix what is listed below and it builds again by itself.

friendly.duplicate: Two blocks have the same name. Rename one of them.

friendly.command: A formula or a piece of text uses a command that is not known. Check the spelling of the formula.
friendly.brackets: A bracket, brace or dollar sign is not closed. Look for a missing } or $ near this place.
friendly.missingFile: A file that the thesis needs was not found.
friendly.capacity: Something in the thesis is too tangled to be typeset. Look at the place that is named, or at a formula or a footnote in a heading.
friendly.other: Something here could not be turned into a PDF.
friendly.commandNamed: A formula or a piece of text uses a command that is not known: {{command}}. Check that it is spelled correctly.

noWatermark: This thesis has no watermark image, so none is drawn. Choose a school in the settings or use an image of your own.
